name: Tibet Add-On Tour from Kathmandu
alt_names: Lhasa and Everest North Base Camp tour
sub_region: Lhasa; Shigatse (Tingri / Everest North Base Camp); Ngari (Mount Kailash)

difficulty.notes: Touring by vehicle, but at high altitude from day one (Lhasa ~3,656 m); EBC and Kailash variants go above 5,000 m.

duration_days.basis: Kathmandu - Lhasa - Kathmandu by air (Lhasa-only fly-in tour)
duration_days.notes: Variants: 8-10 day Lhasa - Gyantse - Shigatse - Everest North Base Camp; overland Kathmandu-Kerung-Lhasa (normally ~8 days) is CLOSED as of Oct 2026; Kailash kora trips (~12-16 days) via Lhasa or via Nepalgunj-Simikot-Hilsa. Check 2026 status before selling any variant.

max_altitude_point: Lhasa (for the standard fly-in tour; EBC variant ~5,150-5,200 m)

itinerary.route: Kathmandu - Lhasa Gonggar (flight ~1 h 20 min) - Lhasa; rest for acclimatization
itinerary.notes: Tibetan guide meets the group holding the Tibet Travel Permit.

itinerary.route: Day trip to Yamdrok Lake (~4,441 m) or Namtso, or further Lhasa sights
itinerary.notes: Optional; altitude figures for lakes from a single travel site.

best_seasons.notes: Operator guidance; Tibet has historically been closed to foreigners for periods around February-March, though operators report no March closure expected in 2026. Kathmandu-Lhasa flight schedules were published only to October 2026.

permits.name: Tibet Travel Permit (TTB permit)
permits.fee: Not officially published; included in operator package (one operator cites ~CNY 300-500)
permits.applies_to: all foreign nationals; only via a licensed Tibet travel agency, no independent applications

permits.name: Chinese visa for entry from Nepal (China Group Visa issued in Kathmandu, or eligible individual visa / visa-free entry)
permits.fee: Varies by nationality (Chinese Embassy Kathmandu fee schedule; reduced fees continue to 31 Dec 2026)
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals entering Tibet from Nepal

permits.name: Aliens' Travel Permit / Military / Border Defence permits
permits.applies_to: Everest North Base Camp, border areas and Ngari (Mount Kailash)

guide_requirements: Independent travel is not permitted: foreigners must book a pre-arranged itinerary with a licensed Tibet agency and be accompanied by a licensed Tibetan guide with agency transport.

flights: Himalaya Airlines H9-774 Kathmandu-Lhasa / H9-775 Lhasa-Kathmandu (the only nonstop operator in 2026; ~4-5 flights a week)
Kailash variant: Kathmandu - Nepalgunj - Simikot, then helicopter/trek to Hilsa border
drives: Overland Kathmandu - Rasuwagadhi/Kerung (Gyirong) - Lhasa: CLOSED since 26 Aug 2026 flood
logistics.notes: The Chinese side of the border is 2 h 15 min ahead of Nepal time.

highlights: Potala Palace and Jokhang Temple in Lhasa
Everest North Face from Rongbuk / North Base Camp (when open)
Mount Kailash kora and Lake Manasarovar (pilgrimage variant)
Flight across the Himalaya between Kathmandu and Lhasa
risks: Acute mountain sickness on arrival in Lhasa (no gradual ascent on fly-in)
Sudden permit suspensions and border closures
Group-visa rules: all members listed on a group visa must enter and exit together

acclimatization.notes: Fly-in itineraries spend the first 2-3 days in Lhasa before going higher.

unverified: 2026 ACCESS STATUS: the 26 Aug 2026 Bhote Koshi flood destroyed the Rasuwagadhi-Kerung crossing; China suspended Shigatse electronic border-area permits from 28 Aug 2026 (NIA notice) and as of mid-Oct 2026 no reopening date had been announced (Kathmandu Post). Tatopani/Zhangmu is not open to tourists.
Everest North Base Camp (Tibet): one operator reported permit applications reopened 15 Sep 2026, then access suspended again from 20 Sep 2026; status unclear.

Visa rules conflict: some operators say the China Group Visa (minimum 5 people, applied in Kathmandu) is still required; others say individual Chinese visas and China's visa-free policy are now accepted for entry from Nepal. Confirm per nationality.
Kathmandu-Lhasa flights: Himalaya Airlines schedules were published only to October 2026; older sources list Air China/Sichuan Airlines, which no longer appear to fly the route.
Everest North Base Camp altitude cited as 5,150 m or ~5,200 m by different sources; Lhasa 3,656 m from a travel source.
Tibet Travel Permit fee not officially published; ~CNY 300-500 is an operator estimate.
